source_review.notes: Checked current ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018, ISO/IEC 25010:2023 second-edition product-quality model, and ISO/IEC 25023:2016 published/revision-stage metadata; NASA Technical Requirements Definition and requirement appendix; SEBoK 2.14 System Requirements Definition; and edition-bounded Jain and Lilja performance-analysis texts. NASA and SEBoK returned HTTP 200. The three ISO pages returned HTTP 403 to the command-line client; current official metadata was independently inspected during authoring, but command-line reachability is not claimed.

evidence: Reviewed the quantitative-obligation tuple, conditional measurement function, probabilistic requirement form, availability estimator, observation function, arithmetic mean, empirical quantile qualification, proportion, margin sign convention, and readiness predicate.
notation_and_syntax.notes: All symbols are introduced before use; effectiveness, performance, quality, quality in use, budgets, margins, service objectives, TPMs, verification, and validation remain distinct.

evidence: Executed performance-quality-record-check under Python 3.14.4 and independently recomputed five records, one well-formed declared record, missing population PQ-002, missing window PQ-004, missing threshold and vague phrase PQ-003:highly available, and missing uncertainty rule PQ-005.

Recomputed 0.999 cubed as 0.997002999 and simple 0.1 percent of a 30-day month as 43.2 minutes; checked the explicitly approximate three-over-n zero-failure upper-bound heuristic under its stated assumptions.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Arithmetic is correct for declared simplified assumptions. None of these calculations establishes real availability, independence, reliability, sampling adequacy, or operational consequence.

evidence: Re-derived the conditional measurement and statistical requirement forms and verified dimensional separation among duration, rate, capacity, utilization, ratios, and physical quantities.
Checked why empirical quantiles do not generally compose by addition and why serial availability multiplication requires the stated success structure and independence assumptions.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The formal relations are conditional models, not universal proofs or distribution-free guarantees.

evidence: Reviewed empty/low-volume windows, missing/censored data, burst and peak load, tails, subgroup exclusion, clock and boundary mismatch, dependency loss, common-cause failure, partial service, maintenance exclusions, recovery correctness, inaccessible users, rare repairs, zero observed failures, sensor metrology, clinical AI, and wildfire emergency use.

Challenged all ten examples and five answers for proxy substitution, average-only evidence, invented precision, benchmark portability, naive composition, causal overclaiming, and unsupported domain acceptance.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: High-consequence thresholds remain conditional on representative evidence and applicable domain, safety, security, human-factors, community, legal, clinical, and regulatory authority.

evidence: Traced semantic, context, distribution, evidence, and stakeholder-outcome invariants through exposition, ten worked examples, and five complete answers.
Verified every measurement construction identifies or explicitly requests entity, property, conditions, population, method, aggregation, decision rule, uncertainty, source, and verification.
invariant_checking.notes: Metrics remain stable across requirement/test/operation, conditional on workload and population, distribution-aware, evidence-bounded, and linked to outcome guardrails.

proof_review.notes: The chapter provides conditional equations and counterexamples but no theorem proof.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: Reviewed uses of prove, guarantee, evidence, causal, representative, accurate, precise, reliable, available, safe, secure, accessible, compliant, and valid.
artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-014/report.json records exact local execution evidence for declared fields and lexical signals.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Execution establishes declared-record and bounded lexical observations only. It cannot establish stakeholder relevance, statistical sufficiency, future performance, safety, security, clinical benefit, accessibility, regulatory conformity, or external review.

conceptual_review.notes: Professor-style review checked performance, quality, measure, metric, condition, workload, population, threshold, target, objective, tolerance, margin, aggregation, uncertainty, latency, throughput, capacity, accuracy, reliability, availability, maintainability, resilience, service objective, TPM, verification, and validation for conceptual consistency.

practitioner_review.notes: Practitioner-style review checked emergency alerts, APIs, batch pipelines, sensors, service availability, search-language distribution, field repair, percentile composition, zero-failure testing, accessibility automation, clinical classification, medical-device maintenance, and wildfire evacuation. Each example exposes assumptions, intermediate calculations, evidence limits, and bounded conclusions. Internal practitioner-oriented review only.

pedagogical_review.notes: Pedagogical review confirmed progression from outcome/function linkage through measurement boundary, conditions, units, aggregation, timing/capacity, metrology, resources, quality models, reliability/recovery, human qualities, thresholds, interactions, inference, and operational evidence. Ten examples and five complete answers require critique, rewriting, recomputation, evidence design, and emergency transfer.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
